greeting.text: Orientation Officer Reyes. One note before we start: access above deck six is temporarily restricted. Nothing to be concerned about - the tour still runs.

what_happened.text: A debris field. A stellar accident, nothing more - the kind of thing every long crossing logs a few of. Repairs are proceeding on schedule. I can still take you to every deck; the routing's just been adjusted.

starting_tour.text: This way. Deck seven is sealed for now, purely as a precaution, so we'll take the long way round.

later.text: The tour departs from right here whenever you're ready.
